title: Consider adding waitQueueTimeoutMS with higher value
body: Currently waitQueueTimeoutMS is not set, meaning requests queue indefinitely when pool is exhausted. Consider setting waitQueueTimeoutMS: 30000 to fail after 30 seconds instead of hanging forever. However, this may cause MongoWaitQueueTimeoutError during cold starts - needs testing.
rationale: Without waitQueueTimeoutMS, pool exhaustion causes indefinite queuing. A 30s timeout would provide bounded failure.
